###My document

#Loading in my libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(palmerpenguins)
```
This data set has `r count(penguins)` rows.
The mean is `r round(mean(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), 1)`.

These are the penguin species: `r levels(penguins$species)`
